finding: The prevalence of pre-eclampsia among women with COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was around 10%, and women with COVID-19 and a history of chronic hypertension or obesity are more likely to have pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section is increased among women with pre-eclampsia and COVID-19, with increased rates of neonatal admission to intensive care units, mostly due to prematurity.
